instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run tool:track-a-selected-object-in-a-video", and give it video, output, start, end, time, points, model.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:track-a-selected-object-in-a-video and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: The result the item's own job names: Follow an object or a person I pointed at through a clip and get its outline in every frame

worked_examples.title: Follow one thing I point at through a video clip and outline it in every frame (runs on your computer) on a sample input

input.video: <video: The video file, put where {video} is in the command>
input.output: <output: A folder that does not exist yet, put where {output} is>
input.start: <start: Second the stretch begins, put where {start} is>
input.end: <end: Second the stretch ends, at most 30 after start, put where {end} is>
input.time: <time: The second the person pointed at, from start up to but not including end, put where {time} is>
input.points: <points: JSON text: a list of {x, y, include} where x and y are 0 to 1 across and down the picture and include is true for a point inside the object and false for one outside it>
input.model: <model: The SAM 2 video model name in the local Hugging Face cache, put where {model} is>
